name: adb-claw
description: Android device control CLI. Perception is a JPEG frame only. Actions use a 0-999 normalized grid bound to frame_token. Use when controlling, testing, or automating a connected Android device.

adapter.when: Long-lived Gemini Computer Use adapters only. Claude Code and OpenClaw use the one-shot CLI.
adapter.image: inline JPEG from frame path, never base64 in tool JSON

tools.name: observe
tools.description: Copy the newest livestream JPEG to a unique path and frame token. Never looks at UI text nodes.
tools.returns: data.screenshot.path, data.screenshot.frame_token, hash, captured_at, rotation, action/image size, optional frame_age_ms
tools.when_to_use: Before deciding an action, and after type/key/open. Open the JPEG. Do not sleep; the pump already holds the latest frame.

tools.name: tap
tools.description: Tap using a 0-999 grid bound to the latest frame token.
tools.when_to_use: After reading the latest JPEG when only one point is needed. Next token is data.screenshot.frame_token, not top-level data.frame_token.

tools.name: chain
tools.description: Run 2-8 frame-bound gestures on the current JPEG without re-observing. wait-changed runs once after the last step.
tools.usage: adb-claw chain --normalized --frame FRAME_TOKEN --wait-changed 1500 tap X1 Y1 tap X2 Y2
tools.when_to_use: When this JPEG already shows every target (chess: piece then square). Do not chain a target that appears only after the first tap.

tools.name: long-press
tools.description: Long press using 0-999 coordinates.
tools.when_to_use: For context menus or press-and-hold controls.

tools.name: swipe
tools.description: Swipe between two 0-999 points on the current frame.
tools.usage: adb-claw swipe --normalized X1 Y1 X2 Y2 --frame FRAME_TOKEN [--wait-changed 1500]
tools.when_to_use: Custom gesture path. Prefer scroll for paging lists.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll the screen by direction pages.
tools.when_to_use: To reveal more content after reading the current frame.

tools.name: type
tools.description: Type text into the focused field. Unicode uses embedded ACTION_SET_TEXT; no APK or IME change.
tools.when_to_use: After tapping an editable field to focus it. Prefer a known deep link when it avoids UI steps.

tools.name: clear-field
tools.description: Clear the currently focused editable field.
tools.when_to_use: Before retyping into a focused field.

tools.name: key
tools.description: Press a system key.
tools.when_to_use: Back, home, confirm, recents, paste, or device keys.

tools.name: open
tools.description: Open a URL or app deep link.
tools.when_to_use: To jump to a screen or pass CJK text as a URL parameter.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Wait for an activity or a visual screen change. No text locators.
tools.when_to_use: When an action ran without --wait-changed. A changed wait returns data.screenshot.path.

tools.name: app
tools.description: App lifecycle and current package.
tools.when_to_use: Load an App Profile, confirm navigation, or launch/stop a package.

tools.name: screen
tools.description: Screen power, unlock, and rotation.
tools.when_to_use: When the screen is off or locked.

tools.name: device
tools.description: List devices or read model, screen size, Android version.
tools.when_to_use: First session, or when choosing -s SERIAL / Phone vs Pad.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Check adb, device, and stream health.
tools.when_to_use: First request or when a command reports no device.

tools.name: audio
tools.description: Capture system audio as WAV. Not part of the visual decision loop.
tools.when_to_use: Only when the user asks to record or hear device audio. Android 11+.

tools.name: file
tools.description: Push or pull files.
tools.usage: adb-claw file push LOCAL REMOTE | file pull REMOTE LOCAL
tools.when_to_use: When the user asked to transfer files.

tools.name: shell
tools.description: Run a non-UI adb shell command. Rejects hierarchy dumps, layout dumpsys, clipboard binder, and IME changes.
tools.when_to_use: When the user asked for a shell fact (getprop, pm). Never as a vision escape hatch.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Save a picture for a human. Not the observe token loop.
tools.when_to_use: Only when the user wants a saved image file. Do not use it to decide taps.

tools.name: serve
tools.description: Persistent JSONL session: frame.latest / frame.wait_after / act / device.info.
tools.when_to_use: Gemini adapters only. Claude Code and OpenClaw must not start this.

tools.name: pump
tools.description: Explicit livestream control. First observe starts the pump automatically.
tools.usage: adb-claw pump [--daemon] | pump status | pump stop
tools.when_to_use: Only when doctor says the stream is down.

tools.name: bench
tools.description: Measure first frame, screenshot, latest write, and normalized tap latency.
tools.when_to_use: Diagnostics only. Not part of the control loop.

workflow_hints.default_loop: observe → open JPEG → tap|chain|swipe|scroll --normalized --frame TOKEN --wait-changed → open data.screenshot.path. type/key/open then observe. Chain when all targets are already on this JPEG.
workflow_hints.read_image: JSON is only metadata. Open data.screenshot.path before every coordinate action.
workflow_hints.next_token: After --wait-changed, the next token is data.screenshot.frame_token. Top-level data.frame_token is the frame just acted on.
workflow_hints.chain: When every next target is already visible on this JPEG, use chain with that frame_token. Do not tap --wait-changed and re-read between those steps. Do not chain a target that appears only after the first tap.
workflow_hints.image_only: The only perception input is a JPEG file from observe or frame.latest. Do not request a UI tree.
workflow_hints.normalized_coords: All model actions use a 1000x1000 (0-999) grid plus the latest frame_token. Tap the control center, not 500 500 unless that is the target. Bare pixels and unbound normalized actions are rejected.
workflow_hints.stale_frame: STALE_FRAME means the frame action size no longer matches the live screen, or the token expired. Observe again.
workflow_hints.no_sleep: Never insert sleep, time.sleep, adb-claw shell sleep, or a timed pause. Use an action's --wait-changed or wait --changed --after-frame.
workflow_hints.wait_after: One-shot CLI: an action with --wait-changed returns data.screenshot. Without it, use wait --changed --after-frame. Serve uses frame.wait_after.
workflow_hints.changed_false: changed:false still includes the latest JPEG. Treat it as current state. Do not raise --timeout to fake a sleep. Video feeds can flip changed:true without a useful UI change.
workflow_hints.unicode: Focus the field and call type. Never install ADBKeyboard, change IME, or call the raw clipboard service.
workflow_hints.forbidden_shell: Never use shell for UI hierarchy extraction, layout/accessibility dumpsys, clipboard service calls, or IME changes.
workflow_hints.stop_policy: Stop on the goal screen. Stop and ask on login, captcha, payment, or a permission dialog the user must answer. Same hash+point at most twice. Two no-progress frames → change strategy or ask.
workflow_hints.retry_policy: Empty/error/placeholder screens are valid outcomes. Never switch to --raw, pull, a fixed path, or node inspection.
workflow_hints.out_of_loop: screenshot, audio, serve, pump, bench are not the visual decision loop.
workflow_hints.usb_capture: A physical USB device uses auto/stream. Unique frame paths prevent adapter image caching; do not switch to pull for that symptom.
workflow_hints.live_stream: observe reads the latest pump frame. Do not restart capture, insert sleep, or treat a static hash as a stale stream.
workflow_hints.cjk: Prefer a known deep link to reduce steps; otherwise focus the field and use built-in Unicode type.
